name: residential_occupant_coverage
description: REH 4.11 slot 45 GetOccupantCoverage(occ, level, &dist, &radius): radius = e2 x m1 x the coverage radius (200); dist walks the distance curve (0,100) (50,80) (100,0) from its second point, keeping the last point above level x 100 and interpolating at the first at or below it, with the x_prev term missing its 0.01 [quirk]: level 0.5 -> (30 / 80 x 0.5) x 200 + 50 x 200 = 10037.5; level 0.9 -> 50; level 0 -> 10100. No radius -> (0, 0). Neither a school nor a hospital -> AL 0 (null). The service is the hospital when the building has the hospital capacity [question 7].
